thread:
maya: Heads up — planning a breaking change to the partner SDK auth header format. Targeting 2026-05-05 for rollout. Need partner gating plan + marketplace & SI comms.

liam: Thanks. Do we have a hard reason we can't do additive headers for 90 days?

sophia: Additive would be ideal for partners but some HW partners run older SDKs that won't pick it up. Need a shim path.

akiko: We can ship a tiny client shim (npm/pip) that adds compatibility. Small patch, 2-week canary window.

kevin (hw-partner): Our integrators often vendor the SDK into firmware. How long is the grace period? Asking for release planning.

maya: Goal is 90 days grace, but enforcement at 120 days for platform-side auth validation. We should define gating matrix: Marketplace listed partners get 120, SI/custom integrators 150.

julia (marketplace): Marketplace update: we need a page notice + banner 30 days before. Also must update the marketplace package metadata to call out the new header. I can draft text.

omar: Legal wants a 60-day minimum notice for commercial partners. Please include that in external comms.

liam: From infra side we can accept both headers for the transitional window. After that we will reject old header unless partner is on an exception list. Exceptions need an owner.

akiko: Proposed dev flow: 1) publish shim + migration guide; 2) canary with 3 partners; 3) marketplace banner + partner emails; 4) gradual enforcement.

maya: Can we get a short sample migration snippet for SDKs to include in the guide?

liam: Sure — example below, put in README and migration doc:
```http
# old header
Authorization: Bearer <token>
# new header
X-Redwood-Authorization: Bearer <token>
# transitional code (js)
const token = getToken(); fetch(url, { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Authorization': token, 'Authorization': token } });
```

kevin (hw-partner): For devices with pinned binaries, we'll need a signed shim package. Can you publish a static artifact?

maya: Yes — we'll produce signed tarballs and a checksums page. Julia — make sure marketplace links to the artifact.

julia (marketplace): Got it. Also flagging that the marketplace licensing screen needs the new compliance checkbox for partner-vetted shims.

omar: Also keep an audit log of who we granted exceptions to. Compliance will want that exportable.

deploy-bot: scheduled message: SDK-shim v1.0 will be published to internal npm/pypi canary on 2026-04-10T16:00Z.

sophia: Can we create a simple partner-impact spreadsheet (status: SOW, on-shim, vendor-locked) and assign owners? I'll kick it off and share.

maya: Owner asks: Sophia owns partner outreach, Liam owns API gating, Akiko owns SDK shims, Julia handles marketplace pages, Omar covers legal/compliance. Everyone OK with owners?

liam: ok from eng.

akiko: ok from devex.

kevin (hw-partner): I'll be the SI escalation point for our integrators.

maya: Great. Action items: Sophia -> partner spreadsheet (due 2026-03-28). Akiko -> publish shim canary 2026-04-10. Julia -> draft marketplace banner 2026-04-05. Liam -> config toggle for dual-header acceptance 2026-04-08. Omar -> sign-off on external notice wording 2026-04-02.

sophia: I'll ping partners as soon as the spreadsheet is up. :email:

maya: Thanks all — we'll reconvene next week for a final gating checklist. :thumbsup:
